title: The quietest of times, the busiest of times
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: The Summer counts as the quiet season for library news but the busiest for public libraries on the ground. Tons of children coming to the desk asking for stickers and staff encouraging them to read more makes this the best time of year, with more events going on now than any other month. This post we have a report from Lincolnshire on what is going on there and I am sure it is being repeated elsewhere. Do send me your stories about the great things you have done as well.
